text.p: A tremor measuring 5.3 on the Richter scale shook Syria on Wednesday at about 00:15 a.m. (10:15 GMT), the official Syrian News Agency (SANA) said on Wednesday.
There were no reports of injuries.
The tremor was also felt in Israel, where residents called radio stations to say the furniture in their homes was shaking.
The center of the tremor was around 260 km (161 miles) northeast of the Syrian capital Damascus in the heart of the Syrian desert and lasted for about 15 seconds, SANA said.
Earthquakes are not all that uncommon in the eastern Mediterranean.
